rows.text:
Hey there, greedy goblin. I'm Nib. I was just in the middle of enjoying my nap when you had to barge into this dungeon and start swiping loot left n' right!
(Click 'next' to continue)
Well, now you've gone and done it — the monsters are coming to claim their stuff, and you're going to have to defend yourself with that loot or else die in this strange catacomb.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Highlights dungeon wheel)
Welcome to the Merry Go' Round of doom — a series of circular catacombs that rotate around this particular spot. Don't ask me why, the architect of this dungeon doesn't like answering questions.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Highlights single empty slice of dungeon wheel)
This is a Corridor — there are 8 in total. Monsters will pop into these slots as they line up to clean your clock and take your junk.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Highlights player hotbar)
This is your loot. Looks like you started off with some basic loot for this tutorial, but you'll find lots of fancy weapons and armor out here.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Sprite of Nib comes very close to the player, nearly covering 80% of the screen)
Your mission...
(Click to continue)
(Comes closer)
...is to get out of the dungeon with as much loot as possible.
(Returns to his original position)
...Got it?
(Click 'Got It' to continue)
Okay, let me show you how things work a'ROUND these parts.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(in very tiny text, in italics parentheses) — (y'know, cause of the round dungeon...)
(Click to continue)
(Highlight the healthbar)
You have 6 health (HP). You can never have more than 6. If it reaches 0 at any point, you're dead.
(Click to continue)
When you complete a Dungeon (clear out this wheel), you will heal back to full HP. Spend your HP wisely.
(Click to continue)
Alright, that's enough. Let's spin the wheel and learn the rest as we go. Click 'Spin' to randomly choose your first opponent.
(Click 'Spin' — spins the wheel, forcing it to stop on Wizard)
Ahh, a crotchety ol' wizard, eh?
(Click to continue)
(Highlights Wizard's Attack icon)
He looks pretty scary — 5 Attack would nearly kill you in one strike.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights Wizard's HP icon)
...but he's also super frail. Most weapons will kill him before he gets to strike.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights the Sai)
Use the Sai. It will kill him and end the fight.
(Click the Sai to use it, resolving combat as normal)
1 down, nice. When an Enemy is Defeated, it will trigger the Dungeon to Spin again.
(Click to continue)
(Only NOW does the wheel Spin, and will now land on Golem)
Interesting...this Golem is much harder to kill, so you'd usually want to block this.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights Block icon on the character)
Block is temporary for the current fight. It goes away whenever you Spin the Dungeon.
(Click to continue)
But I've got good news — if you Block an enemy, they are also Defeated.
(Click to continue)
(Nib gets 50% closer to the viewer, 'leaning' in)
I guess they just...run out of time to kill you, I guess? Not sure, this Dungeon is kinda weird.
(Click to continue)
(Nib returns to his position)
(Highlights the Helmet item in the hotbar)
Anyway, look at the Helmet, since this item has a unique ability.
(Click to continue)
You can hold Shift to see any Item's details at a glance.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights the detail view panel to the right)
Looks like the Helmet's Block is based on whichever HP is lower between you and your Enemy.
(Click to continue)
(Highlight both player HP and the Golem's HP)
In this case, that's you with 6 HP.
(Click to continue)
Glad you didn't lose 5 HP to the Wizard earlier, that would make this Helmet useless!
(Click to continue)
Items change all the time based on circumstances. Your job is to juggle your loot to maximize their effectiveness against the unique enemies in the dungeon.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights the Helmet again)
Okay, let's use the Helmet and Block this incoming attack.
(Click the Helmet)
(Highlights the 'Safe' button)
This button will always show you how much HP you are going to lose if you end the fight now.
(Click to continue)
Since you are safe, you can click 'Safe' to end the fight.
(Click 'Safe' and resolve the combat)
Great, so you've Defeated enemies in 2 different ways, by Attacking and Defending.
(Click to continue)
There's one final type of item, so let's Spin again and try it out.
(Click 'Spin' and land on Goblin)
Aww, look at this little guy! He is so cute...but he also has an ability.
(Click to continue)
(Highlight on the Monster card)
Hover over any Monster and hold Shift to learn the details of their ability, just like Items.
(When the user hovers and holds Shift, highlight the details)
Aw, Goblins are 'Evasive', so they cannot take Attack damage! Looks like our Knucklers would be wasted here.
(Click to continue)
(Highlight 'Da Boot' in the hotbar)
But wait...this item is a Special Item. It doesn't Attack or Block. Take a look.
(When the user hovers or holds Shift)
This item allows you to instantly Defeat an Enemy if you have more HP than them!
(Click to continue)
That's a good item...
(Click to continue)
(Nib moves close to the viewer)
...but are you sure you want to use it?
(Click to continue)
(Nib returns)
So far you've lost zero HP in this dungeon, but remember — each time you clear a Dungeon, you heal back to full.
(Click to continue)
AND you get to keep all of the Loot that you didn't use in this dungeon. Pretty sweet, huh?
(Click to continue)
So I'll give you a choice. You can use Da Boot and get the sweet satisfaction of stomping this Goblin into the dirt...
(Click to continue)
...Orrrr you can let him slice you up, and keep it. The choice is yours.
(The player will click on either Da Boot or 'Take 3'. Either will resolve the combat)

---(If the player chose 'Da Boot', after combat resolves)---
Honestly, I respect it. Those Goblins are super annoying, so here's a tip:
(Click to continue)
If you see one in your upcoming Dungeon, you should always hold onto a Block or Defeat item to avoid that damage.
(Click to continue)
You won't always have a Boot, after all.
(Click to continue — joins back with standard dialogue)
---(If the player chose to 'Take 3')---
Ouch — hurts, doesn't it?
(Click to continue)
Well the next time that Boot saves you from death in a future Dungeon, you'll be glad you let that little rascal nick you for 3.
(Click to continue)
I'm sure you can tell, but I'll give you a tip straight from the source:
(Click to continue)
Spend your HP like it was made of gold. Sometimes it will be correct to drop to 1 HP — you'll find Items that reward you for losing HP — we call that Bleeding.
(Click to continue — joins back with standard dialogue)
---JOINS TOGETHER
Alright, so you survived all 3 Monsters and cleared the Dungeon! At this point you would venture deeper and the following would occur:
(Click to continue)
First, you'll build a new dungeon with starting Monsters
(Click to continue)
(Highlights 2 random slices)
Then, 2 of those starting Monsters will be upgraded to more dangerous foes
(Click to continue)
(Highlights hotbar)
And finally, you'll keep your remaining Items and draft new items to start the next Dungeon
(Click to continue)
(Nib moves to center screen)
And that's it! Pay special attention each time you encounter a new Monster or Item, and learn their quirks.
(Click to continue)
Some items are very strong against certain monsters, and it's up to you to manage your resources and make it out with the best haul.
(Click to continue)
With that, I'm off to finish my nap again. Good luck with your dungeon delve, you greedy grubber!
(Click to continue)
(Animates Nib 'walking off' to the right)
(vignette background, only buttons below are 'Main Menu' and 'Play', which goes to adventure mode)

rows.text: My knife?! Spit it out!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You steal a blade and smile? I'm smiling next.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 2 of 5

rows.text: That knife leaves with me. Fingers optional.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 3 of 5

rows.text: One knife. Two claimants. Do the math, pest.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Don't throw it. I want it back unbent.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 5 of 5

rows.text: That's MY shield, you little raccoon!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Hide behind it. I'll wait. I've waited worse.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Stolen wood won't save sticky fingers.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Nice grab. Terrible future.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Keep it up. Makes the pry job easier.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Those prongs are mine!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You grabbed my Sai. Now we dance ugly.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Pokey thief. Pokey ending.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Put them down. I asked nice once.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Fancy steal. Still mine.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My luck charm — on YOU?!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Shiny thief. Short career.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 2 of 5

rows.text: That medallion hums for me. You're noise.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Hand it over. I'll be almost polite.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Jewelry on a pest. Classic last mistake.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My helmet! Wrong head!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Cover up. I'll aim anyway.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You swiped my lid. Bold. Dumb.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 3 of 5

rows.text: That metal's mine. Your thoughts can stay.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Wear it. I'll take the rest separately.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 5 of 5

rows.text: MY BOOT — give it!

rows.text: You stole a boot. I stole a seat. Guess who wins.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 2 of 5

rows.text: That's my size. Your foot's a suggestion.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Boot thief. I'm laughing. Then I'm not.

rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My book! Close it!

rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Magic pages. Sticky paws. Bad combo — for you.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Don't crease it. I'll still fold you.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 4 of 5

rows.text: That grimoire called me. You just grabbed.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Those gloves were already my color!

rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Red looks busy on you. It'll look better elsewhere.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Sticky red fingers. Adorable. Temporary.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 4 of 5

rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My plate — on a pest?!

rows.text: Tin thief. Ribs can commute.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Armor stolen. Teeth not.

rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Wrist jewelry. Mine.

rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 3 of 5

rows.text: You packed my flask. I packed appetite.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Keep the symptoms. Return the bottle.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My flail! Spikes AND theft? Respect. Briefly.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 1 of 5

rows.text: That goes back on my wall. You go on the floor.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Finally a thief with taste. Still a thief.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 3 of 5

rows.text: You picked the mean one. I noticed.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Don't name it. I already did.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My juice? Planning to live with MY juice?
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Second chance stolen. I'm reclaiming it full.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Red flask. Red ending. Brand consistent.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Don't sip. I want it sealed.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Sweet steal. I'll take it off the quiet body.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My crossbow! Point it elsewhere, then give it!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Bolt thief. Bow stays. Holes optional.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You aimed MY bow in MY room. Rude.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Don't scratch the stock. Reclaiming soon.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Range on a pest. I brought more range.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 5 of 5

rows.text: MY hammer! Overkill theft. I approve the overkill.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Big tool. Small thief. Short story.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You dragged my sledge into my nest. Fun. Fatal.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Wall can keep the hole. Hammer comes home.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 4 of 5

rows.text: I'll take it. Keep the headache.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My watch! Time's up — not poetry.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Tick. That's me walking. Tock. That's you not.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Nice steal. Time of death: pending.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 3 of 5

rows.text: You grabbed a clock. I grabbed a seat.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Stop winding. I'll stop you.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 5 of 5
